card.name: Comma after inhaled, before short-acting
card.fires_on: The comma right after "an inhaled" in rescue-treatment sentences, just before "short-acting bronchodilator" or "beta 2-agonist". Also fires on the start of "Prescribing" in "substrate Prescribing Information".
